newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police overpower hostage-taker in Munich.
newsitem.headline: German police overpower hostage-taker in Munich.

text.p: Police on Thursday overpowered a man who held a bank employee hostage for more than seven hours as he tried to get into a getaway car, eyewitnesses said.
A police spokesman said the standoff had ended "without bloodshed".
The witnesses said a smoke bomb appeared to have gone off either inside or near the car. There was no immediate news on what had happened to the hostage.
Police had earlier brought money and a getaway car to the scene.
The masked man entered the bank in Munich's Grosshadern district at around 8.30 a.m (0730 GMT) and took a 24-year old male bank employee hostage. Two other people in the bank were able to flee.
Police had sealed off the area shortly after the incident began. It came almost exactly a year after Munich police had to deal with two hostage dramas within 24 hours.
